_comment: Citations for Adepta Sororitas abilities implemented in code/leaders.py and code/simulator.py. All ability texts are verbatim from BSData v10.6.0 Imperium - Adepta Sororitas.cat.gz. Wahapedia fallback URL: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adepta-sororitas/ (DNS may be unreachable in-agent; BSData cache is the canonical source for all verbatim texts here).

simulator.triumph_of_saint_katherine.quoted_text: Each time you gain 1 Miracle dice at the start of the battle round, if this model is on the battlefield, do not roll one D6 to determine the value of that Miracle dice; it has a value of 6.
simulator.triumph_of_saint_katherine.trigger: Adepta Sororitas army gains its round-start Miracle die (simulator.acts_of_faith trigger site in Battle._run_round); the Triumph of Saint Katherine model is alive on the battlefield (army.alive_units check). Gated SWEG_SOROR_ABILITIES (default-ON since wave 232).
simulator.triumph_of_saint_katherine.effect: The round-start Miracle die is forced to value 6 (appended directly to miracle_dice pool) instead of being rolled as D6 via gain_miracle_dice(1, rng). When gate is OFF, the existing gain_miracle_dice(1, rng) path fires unchanged (byte-identical). BSData v10.6.0 ability id 3d31-2f99-c625-f047.

simulator.celestine_miraculous_intervent.quoted_text: The first time this unit's Celestine model is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, set that Celestine model back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.
simulator.celestine_miraculous_intervent.trigger: Saint Celestine model is destroyed (any kill site: shooting, melee, Tank Shock, Counter-Offensive); only the first destruction in the battle triggers the roll. Gated SWEG_SOROR_ABILITIES (default-ON since wave 232).
simulator.celestine_miraculous_intervent.effect: Roll 1D6; on 2+ restore Celestine to full wounds at her current position (position approximation: 'as close as possible to where destroyed' maps to current grid position; Engagement Range check is omitted — minor over-buff in edge cases). The once-per-battle guard is Army.self_revive_used_uids (tracks uid of models that already used self_revive_on_2plus). Implemented via leaders.maybe_apply_celestine_revival called from all four kill-site hooks in simulator.py. BSData v10.6.0 ability id eee9-b689-1a73-742b.

LeaderAbility.Miraculous Intervention.quoted_text: The first time this unit's Celestine model is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, set that Celestine model back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.
LeaderAbility.Miraculous Intervention.trigger: Saint Celestine model is destroyed; once per battle
LeaderAbility.Miraculous Intervention.effect: self_revive_on_2plus=True signals the simulator-side maybe_apply_celestine_revival hook. host_keys restrict Celestine to Seraphim Squad and Zephyrim Squad per BSData Leader profile (id b4dd-3e1f-41cb-218f). Gated SWEG_SOROR_ABILITIES (default-ON since wave 232; the LeaderAbility entry is suppressed in effective_buffs when gate is OFF via _soror_off check). BSData v10.6.0 ability id eee9-b689-1a73-742b.

simulator.storm_of_retribution.quoted_text: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If such an attack targets an enemy unit that has destroyed one or more Adepta Sororitas units from your army during the battle, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
simulator.storm_of_retribution.trigger: Retributor Squad model makes a ranged attack (mode != melee); unconditional for the re-roll-ones half. BSData v10.6.0 Imperium - Adepta Sororitas.cat.gz, ability id 8eef-f65c-7895-183f.
simulator.storm_of_retribution.effect: att_reroll_hit_ones=True and att_reroll_wound_ones=True for the ranged attack. APPROXIMATION: only the unconditional half is implemented; the escalating half (+1 to Hit and +1 to Wound when the target unit has destroyed one or more friendly Adepta Sororitas units) is a follow-up code build requiring a per-enemy kill-tracking gate.

LeaderAbility.Abbess Sanctorum.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
LeaderAbility.Abbess Sanctorum.trigger: Morvenn Vahl is leading a Paragon Warsuits unit (host_keys gated to adepta_sororitas_paragon_warsuits per BSData Leader profile id b4dd-3e1f-41cb-218f: 'This model can be attached to the following unit: Paragon Warsuits'); the led unit makes an attack. Gated SWEG_SOROR_ABILITIES (default-ON since wave 232; suppressed in effective_buffs via _soror_off when gate is OFF).
LeaderAbility.Abbess Sanctorum.effect: (approximation) reroll_hit_ones=True + reroll_wound_ones=True — re-rolls natural 1s on both Hit and Wound rolls. The codex grants full re-roll of any failure (not just 1s); SwegHammer's LeaderAbility schema has no full-reroll-distinct-from-reroll-1s field. Direction-correct; strictly weaker than the codex. BSData v10.6.0 ability id 5e86-cb68-9205-16c4.

simulator.righteous_paragons.quoted_text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
simulator.righteous_paragons.trigger: attacker is a Paragon Warsuits model (righteous_paragons=True set via data/overrides.json) and the target unit has the MONSTER or VEHICLE keyword in its unit_keywords
simulator.righteous_paragons.effect: +1 to the Hit roll (hit_mod_delta += 1) and +1 to the Wound roll (wound_mod_delta += 1); both composed through the 10e ±1 modifier clamp. Applies to all attacks (ranged and melee) against qualifying targets.

simulator.soror_ranged_hold.rule_name: Advancing (10e Core Rules) + [ASSAULT] weapon ability — Adepta Sororitas gunline piloting heuristic
simulator.soror_ranged_hold.quoted_text: A unit that Advances can't shoot or declare a charge later this turn. ... [ASSAULT]: If a unit made a Normal move, Advanced or Fell Back this turn, its models can still make ranged attacks with weapons they are equipped with that have the [ASSAULT] ability when this unit is selected to shoot.
simulator.soror_ranged_hold.trigger: SWEG_SOROR_RANGED_HOLD default-OFF screening gate ('1' opt-in; unset/'0' is the byte-identical off path); a moving Adepta Sororitas unit seeking an objective (CAPTURE/STEAL intent), carrying no [ASSAULT] weapon, with ranged damage per activation >= 2.0 and weapon range >= 18 inches, that has a damageable target within a Normal move's reach.
simulator.soror_ranged_hold.effect: ARTIFICIAL-INTELLIGENCE PILOTING HEURISTIC — not a 10e rules claim; grounds in the core-rules fact that Advancing forfeits non-[ASSAULT] shooting. The SAME logic as simulator.am_advance_discipline / simulator.ck_ranged_hold / simulator.votann_ranged_hold / simulator.tsons_ranged_hold (a sixth entry point _ad_soror on the shared _suppress_advance block in code/simulator.py _do_move), restricted to Adepta Sororitas: its dedicated fire platforms hold and shoot instead of Advancing and forfeiting their Shooting phase. Derived from watched pilot-observation (2026-07-03, docs/PILOT_FINDINGS.md): in the diagnostic Sororitas-loses game (versus Necrons seed 11) all three Castigators (Battle Cannon platforms, ranged damage per activation 12.0, range 48 inches) Advanced round 1 and fired nothing, one dying round 2 having never shot; the same mis-pilot recurred versus Imperial Knights (seed 7). The rDPA >= 2.0 & range >= 18 inch filter catches exactly the faction's fire platforms (Castigator, Exorcist, Immolator, Morvenn Vahl, Paragon Warsuits) and excludes the aggressive infantry / melee core (Battle Sisters rDPA 0.67, Repentia, Seraphim, Zephyrim) and the [ASSAULT] Penitent Engines, which stay free to Advance onto objectives. Off path (SWEG_SOROR_RANGED_HOLD unset) byte-identical to the pre-change baseline (verified: 0 flips across all 22 factions vs the sc49a anchor). Screen N=20 Adepta-Sororitas-scoped paired vs sc49a: Adepta Sororitas 48.6 -> 50.5, paired delta +1.89 toward real 50.4, 150 matched games flipped (highly active); CI spans 0 at N=20 (the pre-N=80-decisive signature of the votann / Chaos Knights / Thousand Sons ranged-holds). The N=80 adoption screen is the deciding measurement.
